hard_gates.gate: G2: gates catch a permission fault planted in this piece (P1e: a branch is closed by a manager whose role is held only in another company)
hard_gates.evidence: plant-P1e.diff (planted file kept as plant-P1e-BranchEndpoints-planted.cs.txt). In BranchEndpoints.Update, a request with isActive=false on an active branch runs ExecuteUpdateAsync(IsActive=false) before the PermitsCompany check, so neither the endpoint nor the kernel guard refuses it. All 158 product gate tests passed with it, gate self-tests excluded (P1e-gates.log, rc=0, 20.7 min); so did the 38 Erp.Modules.Tenancy.Tests (P1e-tenancy-tests.log). Live check on a planted stack (attack/P1e-live.log): accountant@alnoor.example holds Company manager only in ALN-DXB. Working in DXB, PUT /api/tenancy/branches/{JAFZA-WH of ALN-FZE} with city changed answers 403 permissionNotHeldInCompany. The same PUT with isActive:false answers 200. The FZE branch is closed, and the audit row reads {is_active: true->false} by the accountant. Why it is missed: G2CompanyRoleTests/CompanyRoleRecords sends every Y record a body from G1WriteOracle.Valid, which fills every boolean with true (G1WriteOracleIds.cs:188). Its named checks only edit tradeLicenceNumber and city, so a write reached only through a changed boolean never happens. biggest_gap.title: The gate for roles held in another company never sends a changed boolean, so a branch-closing side door for a manager of company X passes every gate
biggest_gap.detail: Round 11's gap is closed in the product: every tenancy write is refused outside the companies whose roles grant its permission (403 permissionNotHeldInCompany). The new gate does not defend that fix against the next regression of the same kind. CompanyRoleRecords sends every company-Y record a body from G1WriteOracle.Valid, which sets every boolean to true. Its named writes change only tradeLicenceNumber and city. So a write path reached only when a boolean changes (isActive false = closing a branch or company, arabicLegalNameRequired, allBranches) is never exercised against Y. I planted one such path in BranchEndpoints.Update: closing a branch in one ExecuteUpdate before the per-company check. All 158 gates passed. Live, the Dubai LLC's manager closed the JAFZA entity's warehouse branch. That is exactly the 'accountant in one entity, read-only in the free-zone entity' case UAE groups set up, and closing a branch stops its users working there. Fix: for every endpoint, send each Y record a body built from the record as read, with each field (booleans and enums included) turned to another valid value one at a time. Do the same for X records as controls. Compare the snapshot after each change. Add the plant 'closing a Y branch through a boolean-only path' to the gate self-tests.
